title: Register a service worker
summary: A service worker is a script that the browser can run separately from the page.
introduction: A service worker is a script that the browser can run separately from the page. Your task: Find the worker scope in browser developer tools.
learningObjectives: Find the worker scope in browser developer tools.
Explain the example for register a service worker

blocks.text: A service worker is a script that the browser can run separately from the page. It can handle requests within its scope.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.
Read the code step by step

items: `register` loads the service-worker file at the named URL. That URL helps decide which page paths it may control.

blocks.text: On HTTPS or localhost, the browser tries to install sw.js. Put an actual worker file at that path.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A worker file normally controls its folder and lower paths. Its location affects its scope.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the worker scope in browser developer tools.
